A Taddhita affix of the superlative degree applied to nouns,
 adjectives and also to verbs and indeclinables in which latter case it
 is changed to {#tamAm#}; {#aSva˚#} <ls>Pt. 5</ls> ‘the best horse’; {#suhfttama#}
 <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; so {#pacatitamAm#}. It is also added to pronouns in the sense of
 ‘one of many’ {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} {#katama, yatama, tatama#} <ab>&c.</ab>
